An [[Army/Legends|army]] of '''volunteer soldiers''' served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|merumeru|Merumeru}}</ref> When word spread across [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] would soon be invading [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from all across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] rushed to the coastal [[City/Legends|city's]] defense.<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Merumeru's volunteer soldiers fought on [[Ground warfare/Legends|the ground]] during the battle, and were one element of a much larger Wookiee force that also included [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|aerial]] [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft/Legends|vehicles]]. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and several [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] fought alongside the Wookiees.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
